sources.fullCitation: Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann, music; Gus Kahn, lyrics. “You’re All I Need,” from Escapade (Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer). New York: Robbins Music Corporation, 1935. Partial sheet music, pp. 1–2 and 6 only. USC Polish Music Center, Bronisław Kaper Collection, call number PMC 5/36; USC Digital Library, unique identifier UC17193693, legacy identifier kaper-sheet-536-partial, publisher number SH 1304-3. Digital publisher: University of Southern California Libraries. DOI 10.25549/pmc_09-03-2026_11-05-25_PM-oUC17193693.
sources.title: You’re All I Need, 1935 [sheet music, pp. 1–2 & 6 only]
sources.repository: University of Southern California Digital Library
sources.creator: Bronisław Kaper (composer); Walter Jurmann (composer); Gus Kahn (lyricist)
sources.researchNote: USC identifies both the creation and issue year as 1935 and distinguishes Robbins Music Corporation as the original publisher from USC Libraries as the digital publisher. The online document contains only pages 1–2 and 6; the linked local medium reproduces the cover, not the complete score.
